sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent record of five consecutive wins followed by a draw, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Alsager arrive in dire form, sitting bottom of the league with just 4 points from 10 matches and a five-game losing streak, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their unbeaten run.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to bounce back from their recent draw. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between the third and fifth-placed teams, a significant battle in the upper reaches of the table. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the standings, face Wednesfield Community at home in what should be a more straightforward assignment. Bilston Town, sixth and in strong form with back-to-back wins, host struggling Foley Meir. Barnton, seventh and showing mixed recent results, visit Shawbury United, who are battling relegation form with five losses in their last six outings. Market Drayton Town, 10th and inconsistent, travel to face New Mills, who sit eighth and are also struggling with recent defeats. Cheadle Heath Nomads, second-bottom with just 7 points, head to Telford Town—a duel between two of the division's weakest sides. Finally, Widnes Town, pointless this season with no wins from seven games, visit Brereton Social, creating a match involving one of the league's most troubled teams.
